National Anti-Ragging Helpline

Students who face ragging can call the National Anti-Ragging Helpline 1800-180-5522 (24x7 Toll Free) or email helpline@antiragging.in for immediate help. Complaints are forwarded to the institution and the police.

In an emergency, dial 112. For cyber crime, call the helpline number 1930. Founded in 2009.
